text: たまに　シバ　せんぱいも　この　おんせんに　はいられて　せんぱいと　ポケモンの　ケガを　なおして　いらっしゃるんだ

structure.jp: たまに　シバ　せんぱいも
structure.en: once in a while Bruno, my senior, too

structure.jp: この　おんせんに　はいられて
structure.en: comes into this hot spring and

structure.jp: せんぱいと　ポケモンの　ケガを
structure.en: his own and his Pokémon's injuries

structure.jp: なおして　いらっしゃるんだ

patterns.name: 〜られる (honorific)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending here does not mean something is done to him. It is a polite way to speak of what a respected person does. はいられて = '(he) gets in, and'.

patterns.name: 〜ていらっしゃる
patterns.span: なおして　いらっしゃる
patterns.explanation: ていらっしゃる is the respectful form of ている, used for something a respected person is doing or does regularly. なおして　いらっしゃる = '(he) heals'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining something to the listener. いらっしゃるんだ = 'he does, you see'.
